text: Bacon fays, " Mer feek not to know their own flock, and abilities, but fancy their puffellions to be greater, and their abilities lets, than they really arc." Which is in effect dying. " That we ought to exert more than we do, and that, on exertion, our probability of fuccefs is greater than we conceive."

parsed.modern: Bacon says, " Men seek not to know their own flock, and abilities ; but fancy their possessions to be greater, and their abilities less, than they really are." Which is in effect saying, " That we ought to exert more than we do ; and that, on exertion, our probability of success is greater than we conceive."
